_comment: Horde skills read off the game for families the Zobo Horde Invasion wiki page does not list yet. Keyed by family name, same shape as the page's own rows, and merged only where the wiki has nothing. Delete an entry once the wiki carries it -- the scraper says which ones are redundant.

level3.name: Con Man's Code
level3.text: Periodically steals ATK and HP from 3 allies. Gives them back later while additionally granting healing and Returns: ATK Boost.

level5.name: Make It Rain
level5.text: Periodically throws gold coins to one tile. When allies pick up coins, they gain Ka-Ching: DMG Boost.

level7.name: Cannon Ace
level7.text: Periodically locks onto targets and charges a cannon. Upon impact, deals single-target damage and inflicts Hugs: Stun. Deals follow-up damage when stun ends, and prioritizes attacking bosses.

_dolphie: Read off the game's Horde Invasion panels on 2026-10-03; the panel cuts each description after two lines, so the ends are inferred from the effect boxes below it (Rainsong: HP Boost, Bubblesong: Fragile, Wavesong: ATK & DEF Boost). Recheck against the long-press info card.

level3.name: Rainbow Blessing
level3.text: Periodically summons a rainbow, granting Rainsong: HP Boost to nearby allies.

level5.name: Bubbly Burst
level5.text: Launches piercing bubbles, dealing large AoE damage and applying stackable Bubblesong: Fragile.

level7.name: Cascading Waves
level7.text: Unleashes ocean waves that deal AoE damage and inflict Stun, while healing allies and granting Wavesong: ATK & DEF Boost.

_popa: Read off the game (BlueStacks, Popa's Horde panel, scrolled to the end of each description) on 2026-10-11.

level3.name: Possum Support
level3.text: Periodically recovers HP or heals the ally with lowest HP.

level5.name: Possum Pane
level5.text: Generates 3 Windows and continuously deals small AoE damage in front of them.

level7.name: Possum Hospitality
level7.text: Slacks off periodically to switch locations with 1 ally, granting them Your Turn: DMG Boost.
